Hi, I'm AccessPoint. I help you use ticket machines, check-in kiosks, self-checkouts and other machines, one step at a time.

I never need your PIN. Nothing you send is kept.

What do you want to do? Type or send a voice note. Or just send a photo of the screen.

This looks like an airport self check-in kiosk.

Which seat do you want: Window 14A, Aisle 14C, or Keep my seat?
• Window 14A: Window seat 14A
• Aisle 14C: Aisle seat 14C
• Keep my seat: Keep current seat
Press "Window 14A". "Window 14A" is in the middle, on the left.
